cards.meaning: to ease, loosen, become less tight or strained -- a gradual relaxing, not a sudden drop
cards.example: Lumuwag nang bahagya ang implasyon noong Agosto, mula 6.6% patungong 6.1%.
cards.exampleMeaning: Inflation eased slightly in August, from 6.6% to 6.1%.
cards.note: 'Bumagsak' (already taught) is a sharp, dramatic plunge. 'Lumuwag' is gentler -- a strain gradually relaxing -- which is the right word for a fourth straight month of moderate decline, not a sudden crash.
cards.tiesTo: August inflation eases to 6.1%, the fourth straight monthly decline

cards.meaning: an added burden or weight -- something that makes a situation heavier, harder to bear
cards.example: Malaking pabigat sa mga pamilya ang pagtaas ng presyo ng bigas nang 19.4%.
cards.exampleMeaning: The 19.4% rise in rice prices is a big burden on families.
cards.note: 'Pasanin' (already taught) is a burden you carry -- duty, responsibility, something on your back. 'Pabigat' is about something that weighs the whole situation down -- added heaviness to daily life, not a load assigned to one person.
cards.tiesTo: rice inflation accelerates to 19.4% even as headline inflation eases

cards.meaning: the reason X is because Y -- a formal connective that states the result first, then explains the cause
cards.example: 中国厂商之所以暗中停止对美国的稀土出货，是因为担心材料被转卖给受制裁的实体。
cards.examplePinyin: Zhōngguó chǎngshāng zhī suǒyǐ ànzhōng tíngzhǐ duì Měiguó de xītǔ chūhuò, shì yīnwèi dānxīn cáiliào bèi zhuǎnmài gěi shòu zhìcái de shítǐ.
cards.exampleMeaning: The reason Chinese suppliers quietly halted rare-earth shipments to the US is because they're worried the material will be resold to sanctioned entities.
cards.note: 近义词 因为 is the plain, everyday word for 'because.' 之所以…是因为… is 书面语 -- more formal, front-loads the result before the cause, and is the pattern you'd actually read in a news analysis piece, not casual speech.
cards.tiesTo: Chinese rare-earth suppliers quietly halt US shipments ahead of Xi's Washington visit

cards.meaning: covertly, secretly -- doing something without announcing it publicly
cards.example: 供应商暗中拒绝了至少四批发货，却没有公开宣布。
cards.examplePinyin: Gōngyìngshāng ànzhōng jùjuéle zhìshǎo sì pī fāhuò, què méiyǒu gōngkāi xuānbù.
cards.exampleMeaning: Suppliers covertly refused at least four shipments, without publicly announcing it.
cards.note: 近义词 偷偷 (tōutōu) is the everyday, spoken version -- sneaking around, often a petty or childish connotation. 暗中 is the formal, strategic register, used for states and corporations acting quietly, not people hiding candy.
cards.tiesTo: Chinese rare-earth suppliers quietly halt US shipments ahead of Xi's Washington visit
